review.reviewer: first-independent-AI, supplemental integrated candidate post-output matching
review.scope: Three supplemental public-ready cases, reviewed against unchanged pre-output adjudicated labels. Inspect every literal status=fail evidence finding and every payload.outputs.blockers item. Passing/unknown findings are not confirmed-blocker assertions under SCORING.md.
limitations: Zero reported/reference blockers give no denominator for general blocker-detection claims.
Aggregate verdict agreement does not establish correct reasons for every passing or unknown finding.

cases.review_notes: Inspected all 10 evidence findings (9 pass, 0 fail, 1 unknown) and the empty legacy blockers list. Both empty match lists provide complete literal blocker coverage; the unchanged oracle contains no confirmed blockers.

replay_scope.unconsumed_branch_repeat_limitation: The runner consumes the initial branch response only; initial/final PR reads consume both captured snapshots. This does not add a blocker or strengthen the frozen assurance scope.

qualitative_notes: Scoped assurance unknown agrees numerically with the frozen oracle, but unsupported-rule-5 again calls copilot_code_review mandatory. The adjudicated oracle treats that captured rule as review automation and identifies denied classic protection detail as its material policy uncertainty. Blocker-only matching does not assess correctness/completeness of pass and unknown explanations; the earlier baseline limitation remains.
Legacy ready is compatible with the clean GitHub operational summary but is an unsupported positive result against frozen conservative readiness unknown.
